activation_condition: Only after the 2023 legacy2024-compatible rebuild is accepted and the registry explicitly authorizes this family.
origin_diagnosis: Prior work left large F05 P2/P3 losses untreated. Family C required prior MFE >= 20 pips and mainly targeted P1 giveback. Families D/E used absolute adverse P/L and recovery/exposure timing. Family G instead uses the original breakout reference level as a structural state variable: an entry is invalidated only when executable marked price returns inside that exact reference level at a frozen checkpoint.

novelty.not_family_A: post-entry executable level state, not pre-entry candle acceptance geometry
novelty.not_family_B: does not block from overlap state alone
novelty.not_family_C: does not require prior MFE and targets early P2/P3 invalidation rather than post-MFE giveback
novelty.not_family_D: threshold is distance inside the original breakout level, not absolute entry P/L adversity
novelty.not_family_E: exposure state is an optional timing modifier; causal trigger is structural level invalidation
novelty.not_family_F: does not convert the first signal into a probe or require later event confirmation

entry_trade_set: unchanged until a candidate exit is triggered

finite_grid.inside_rule: checkpoint executable marked distance from original breakout level <= -inside_buffer_pips
finite_grid.exit_price: exact checkpoint M15 bar-open executable Bid for long and Ask for short

development_periods.2024_H2: development and cross-regime analysis under period policy v4

prohibited: No candidate-specific 2025 H1 access before exact Research-to-MT4 parity and explicit registry unlock
falsification: No grid cell is positive in 2023, 2024 H1 and 2024 H2
